canonical_edition: Fragmentum ap. Oribasium. CMG, vol. 6.2.1, p. 286. Cf. ORIBASIUS Med. (0722 001)
sources_tested: Exact Canon cross-reference; local open-corpus and scan-source searches for Oribasius/Menecritus; official Corpus Medicorum Graecorum (BBAW) landing page for Raeder's CMG VI 2,1; BBAW METS page-to-image mapping for printed p.286; targeted catalogue and web searches for Menecritus/Menecrates in Oribasius
open_text_result: No exact project-compatible machine-readable transcription was verified. The BBAW CMG service establishes the edition and location but supplies a page-image viewer, not a stated reusable text licence; its provider text/OCR was not used.
scan_result: The official BBAW digitisation is an exact edition-level candidate: Raeder, CMG VI 2,1 (1931), Oribasius, Collectiones medicae books 24–25 and 43–48. Its METS mapping identifies printed p.286 as image 0286. Rights and visual quality were not admitted/audited, so it is a remote lead only and no image was acquired.
scan_rights: No explicit reuse licence found on the official CMG page or its available metadata; obtain BBAW terms/permission before any scan acquisition. No local image was downloaded.
next_action: Keep the cross-reference attached to Oribasius 0722.001. First audit the official p.286 image visually in-browser and obtain an explicit BBAW reuse authorisation; only then queue the host scan for in-house OCR. Do not use provider OCR or create a duplicate Menecritus package.
notes: The Canon explicitly identifies this as a cross-reference, not an independent work.
